reviews.title: Has so much potential
reviews.text:
So everything is expensive and sometimes the AI generates some monsters that may not add up or when evolving weapons just float. 

Biggest complaint, level and strength and weaknesses don’t matter even a little. It’s so annoying to fight and you’ll have pros on resistance and on their weakness and you lose or you’ll have more than one hit and they have one and they do the same amount of damage as you. Or they will be at 40 health and somehow every time your attacks deal 5 and 13 damage and it takes longer to kill them then when they were at full health. 

The other annoying thing is health doesn’t matter. You could have 800 health and they have 350. Every hit from you and them are equal. There’s no being better it’s literally just click and hope you last longer than they do. The combat needs so much help and assistance. Doesn’t seem like they care. Which is the main focus of the game and they miss the mark.

reviews.title: Potential to be a great game
reviews.text: If there was a way to earn gems, even if it was just a percentage of what other players pay to buy monsters through the trading system, this game would be so much fun to grind. The fact that progressing any monster past the second rarity requires gems pretty much makes the game pay-to-play, and it’s a great way to make sure no one plays this game for longer than a few days.

reviews.title: Creature Limit
reviews.text:
Gameplay is EXTREMELY limited. You're capped at 10 monsters unless YOU SPEND MONEY. No ads options. No gameplay options. 


I understand the game needs to make money. But let loyal players earn crystals to unlock new creatures. In the long run this will bring more people to the game and allow you to make more money from new players hearing about the game through loyal players. I don't know if the game is popular enough to do ads, but if so, DO ADS FOR GEMS.

Otherwise. monetization is affecting play time. You max your characters beat all the places and its done. The concept is super cool. But the game is so limited.

Id look at top earning games and theyre formats. Typically gameplay is not affected by in-app purchases (pay to win style) instead they sell cosmetics. You're sitting on a treasure trove of selling cosmetics only. 

there's just such a limit to the game concept with 10 creatures.

reviews.title: Greedy
reviews.text: The game tops your monster level out at level 5, and the any creature above grey rank requires diamonds to re-roll their stats.  The game is playable without diamonds, but to enjoy the game and rank higher you’ll need diamonds.  Also to unlock most of the events you need diamonds.  The game basically revolves around diamond use and there’s nothing you can do to get free diamonds.  There’s a market for trading monsters, but you list your for gold only and when it shows up on the market it cost your gold amount and a certain amount of diamonds.  Why?  I’m not even sure you get those diamonds.  The game hard sets a minimum cost for each monster, meaning you can’t list anything below the default price.  There’s also no way to filter the market, you have to scroll through everything to randomly find a creature you might want, but even then if you click on it, it may say no longer available.  There’s a lot more I can comment about, but I would stay away from the game if you don’t want to spend money.

reviews.title: Awesome in theory, 3 stars for trying
reviews.text:
The concept that each person can have unique monsters by what they scan is super intriguing, but here’s the truth;
1)There is only enough monsters to battle based on current level so if you are just starting you can only play maybe 3-6 battles Total and then you are done til those battles reset. 
2) once you have your 8 monsters which happens pretty quick , you are stuck with what you have because you MUST pay to
Expand your monster slots. The ability to earn monster slots faster by paying is fine but to not have any alternative is poor planning. Think pokemon go, you
Can pay for coins to
Increase monster storage
Or you can leave a monster in a gym each day and in 4 days you can expand. Ultimately you end up stacking a ton of monster generating cores on this game and the only way to use them is to
Delete one of your monsters or pay to expand 
3) appearance modifiers,
Have the potential
To make cool monsters even cooler but also have the ability to make to take a fierce monster and give him a head on a tail that looks absolutely ridiculous. Making it somewhat dangerous to use them on your monster you like. 
4) the battle sequences becomes pretty repetitive, pick the guys on your team against a opposing team, for each guy you pick just pick the one that has a green up arrow and you usually will
Do well . 

All this being said it’s playable, it’s a solid
Idea, but ultimately I see someone coming in with a knock off of this game that incorporates the items I just said,
Rendering any money spent on this particular game, a waste. 
This game seems to be a first to market as far as what I’ve played and they did a good job giving people a road map but seems there was too
Much thought on how to get paid back but missed the mark on hooking players for long term and getting g incremental purchases over time which I think will be the downfall. 
As I said, it’s a good game I’m just giving my personal
Opinion

reviews.title: Would be better if
reviews.text: Dear Warcodes Support Team,I am writing to express my frustration regarding the current monster storage limitations in the game.Warcodes is built around scanning barcodes and collecting diverse monsters, yet the gameplay loop is severely halted by the incredibly low inventory cap. Allowing only a single 5-slot expansion using in-game tokens before forcing players into real-money paywalls feels overly restrictive. It significantly disrupts the enjoyment of collecting and experimenting with different teams.I strongly urge the development team to consider adding more free-to-play pathways to earn storage slots, such as unlocking inventory space through gameplay milestones, scanning specific rare barcode tiers, or allowing repeatable token purchases at increasing costs, or maybe ways to earn gems in game even.Thank you for your time and for considering this feedback. I hope to see adjustments made in a future update to make the game more accommodating for dedicated players.

reviews.title: Free to Play option does not exist
reviews.text:
I really want to like this game, but when starting out all opponents vastly will outclass you, necessitating immediate purchase of pay currency to be even remotely competitive.  

Healing a defeated monster takes 50 minutes or immediately with a small amount of real money.  There is only one 50 minute healing slot, but more slots can be purchased with real money. 

Am I missing something about starting out?  Games of this type almost always have a free to play option which are fodder for the pay to play players, who are in turn fodder for the whales.  Free to play seems to amount to taking 2 minutes to lose a battle then taking 3 hours to heal my 3 monsters.  😜
